symbols.name: block length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions in the block that the shift rotates, a count of those positions.
symbols.quote: Let $J$ be the number of positions in the block.

symbols.name: position
symbols.meaning: A position in the block, numbered from 0 to J-1.
symbols.quote: Let $\zeta$ be a position, numbered $0$ to $J-1$, and let $\xi_\zeta$ be the value stored there.

symbols.name: stored value
symbols.meaning: The value stored at position zeta of the block.
symbols.quote: Let $\zeta$ be a position, numbered $0$ to $J-1$, and let $\xi_\zeta$ be the value stored there.

symbols.name: offset
symbols.meaning: The amount of rotation, an integer taken modulo J.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ be the offset, an integer taken modulo $J$.

symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits in the array, a count of its data bits.
symbols.quote: Let $V$ be the number of stored bits.

relations.quote: A controlled cyclic shift rotates the values of a target [address field](address-field.md) whose offset is set by control bits before it.
A controlled cyclic shift measures its cost in [Running time cost](running-time-cost.md).
